newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banerj base price set at 436.7 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Banerj base price set at 436.7 mln reais.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Rio de Janeiro has set the minimum price of its state bank Banerj, which is to be privatized December 17, at 436.693 million reais, said a spokeswoman for the state planning office.
The state has also set the minimum price of the bank's insurance firm Banerj Seguros, which will be sold off along with the bank, at 43.310 million reais.
Investors will be required to buy the bank and the insurance firm together, the spokeswoman said.
"Although the state has set one price for the bank and another for the insurer, investors will have to present bids that amount to at least 480 million reais," she said.

The Rio de Janeiro state government is selling off 1,492,759,736 common shares in Banerj or 99.97 percent of the bank's total capital, and 911,668 ordinary shares in Banerj Seguros or 100 percent minus one share of the insurer's total capital.
Banerj will be sold off at a closed-envelope privatization auction and interested investors will have until December 6 to pre-qualify.

So far seven financial institutions have pre-qualified for the auction. They are Brazil's Bradesco, Banco Itau and Companhia de Investimentos Latino Americana, BBA Creditanstalt, CCF and General Electric Co.
